$comment: Runtime/output canonical types for the TMX implementation. The data-model schema (tmx.schema.json) covers the STATIC Flow definition and declares the runtime Pipeline 'out of scope' (SCHEMA.md decision 6). This sidecar fills that gap: it is the authoritative shape of what the engine PRODUCES — pipeline state wrapping, task results, the eval scorecard, diagnostics, the event stream, the run record, and the typed error categories. It is the contract the Rust types in tmx-core serialise to; every $def here is described in prose under docs/specs/ (chiefly 01-domain-model.md and 08-errors-and-observability.md).
title: TMX runtime canonical types
description: Authoritative shapes for the values the TMX engine emits at runtime.

RunId.title: Run identifier
RunId.description: A UUIDv7 identifying a single Pipeline run. Time-ordered, so a lexical sort is chronological (RunStore listings need no separate timestamp key).

Milliseconds.title: Milliseconds
Milliseconds.description: A non-negative whole number of milliseconds. The normalised wall-clock unit for all durations the engine reports.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: An RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 instant in UTC, produced via the Clock port.

RunStatus.title: Run status
RunStatus.description: Terminal or in-flight status of a Pipeline. `ok` and `failed` are terminal success/failure; `cancelled`/`timed_out` are terminal via the cancellation contract.

TaskStatus.title: Task status
TaskStatus.description: Outcome of a single task. `ok` = ran and succeeded; `skipped` = `if` evaluated falsy; `error` = the task failed (aborting the Pipeline, or recorded in place under continueOnError).

PipelineState.title: Pipeline state
PipelineState.description: The single JSON object threaded through a run. Each task's output is merged in under its name (or `output` key): `state[name] = output`. Always a JSON object at the top level. Held in memory; its serialised size is bounded by the state cap (see 04-execution-engine.md).

MessageWrapper.title: Wrapped text output
MessageWrapper.description: How non-JSON UTF-8 text output is normalised into the Pipeline state (README contract).

BlobWrapper.title: Wrapped binary output
BlobWrapper.description: How non-UTF-8 binary output is normalised into the Pipeline state. The bytes are base64-encoded and count toward the state size cap.

ErrorCategory.title: Core error category
ErrorCategory.description: The typed error categories the core returns. The core knows nothing about exit codes; the CLI adapter maps these to process exit codes (run_failure→1, validation→3, resolution→4, environment→5, timeout→124, interrupt→130). Usage errors (exit 2) are raised by the CLI adapter itself and are not a core category.

RunError.title: Run error
RunError.description: A typed failure returned by the core, carrying its category, a stable code, a human message, and optional context (the task or reference that failed).

task.description: Name of the task that produced the error, when applicable.

path.description: JSON pointer or reference path the error relates to, when applicable.

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
Diagnostic.description: A finding from `validate` or `lint`. Validation diagnostics come from the SchemaValidator; lint diagnostics come from static reference/`produces`/secret analysis.

path.description: Location of the finding: a file path with a JSON pointer, or an interpolation expression.

TaskResult.title: Task result
TaskResult.description: The per-task record produced by the runner. `output` is present when status is `ok` (or `error` under continueOnError); `error` is present when status is `error`.

name.description: The task name (its state key unless overridden by `output`).

output.description: The JSON the task merged into the state. Any JSON type after normalisation (object, or a message/blob wrapper).

EvalCase.title: Eval case result
EvalCase.description: One dataset case's scored result inside a scorecard.

case.description: The dataset case object that was evaluated (bound as ${{ case }}).

output.description: The subject's output for this case (bound as ${{ output }}).

scores.description: Per-scorer score in [0,1], keyed by scorer name.

score.description: The case score: the weighted mean of its scorers' scores.

passed.description: Whether the case score is at or above passScore (default 0.5; taken from the eval threshold when one is set).

EvalSummary.title: Eval summary
EvalSummary.description: Aggregate metrics over all cases in a scorecard. Includes every metric the `evalThreshold` enum can gate on — `min` and `p90` included.

passRate.description: Fraction of cases whose score is at or above passScore.

Scorecard.title: Scorecard
Scorecard.description: The value an `eval` task merges into the Pipeline state under its name.

passed.description: Overall pass/fail. True when no threshold is set, or when the threshold metric meets its `min`.

Event.title: Run event
Event.description: One entry in the canonical event stream. The `event` field discriminates the variant; the ndjson reporter emits one Event per line. Every payload value is passed through the Masker before emission. Closed like every other $def here: a new payload field is a schema change, not an ad-hoc addition.

id.description: The run id; present on run-level events.

name.description: Task or hook name; present on task.*/hook.* events.

reason.description: Why a task was skipped; present on task.skip (e.g. 'if=false').

output.description: Masked task output; present on task.finish.

index.description: Zero-based item/case index; present on map.item.finish and eval.case.finish.

error.description: The failure that occurred; present on task.error.

RunRecord.title: Run record
RunRecord.description: What the RunStore persists per run at ./.tmx/runs/<id>/. A record, not a journal: a final-state snapshot plus the ndjson event log. No replay/durability semantics.

flow.description: The flow name or source path.

finalState.description: The merged Pipeline state at run end, secrets masked.
